name: TC-PAYMENT-E2E: Complete Generate Payment Link → New Prospect → Product Selection → Link Generation
description:
Complete multi-step wizard flow:
1. Click 'Generate Payment Link' -> Click 'New' to open Prospect creation
2. Fill Prospect details (Name, 10-digit Mobile, Email, GSTIN/Remarks)
3. Click 'Save and Continue'
4. Select Product / Edition / Validity & verify Amount
5. Click 'Save and Continue' / 'Generate Payment Link'
6. Verify Success Toast & generated link record in Payments Listing
